title: Chunkmirage
description: What chunkmirage exchanges; generated by `chunkmirage schema`.

Cast.description: Convert to another data type, e.g. float32 → uint8 for viewers that need integers.

dtype.description: Target numpy dtype name: uint8, uint16, uint32, uint64, int16, float32, ...

clip.description: Clip values to the target integer range first (avoids wrap-around, e.g. 300 → 255 not 44).

Cast.title: Cast

Contacts.description:
Contact sites between two structures, the first two channels of a ``stack://`` source:
the voxels within ``radius`` of both. A mask; follow with ``label`` to colour and
size-filter the sites.

radius.description: Reach, in voxels: a voxel is a contact site when both structures lie within this distance of it (Euclidean). The halo is radius + 1.

a_low.description: Values at or above this in the first channel are the first structure: 128 for a uint8 probability map, 1 for a segmentation.

b_low.description: The same threshold for the second channel, the second structure.

Contacts.title: Contacts

Diff.description:
Change along one axis: each voxel minus the one ``lag`` steps before it on ``axis``
(float32). Along time, what changed since the frame or day before: a hurricane's cold
wake in sea temperature, a flare brightening the sun. The first ``lag`` steps of the
array compare against its first.

axis.description: The axis to difference along, counted from the first (0: time in a t, y, x series).

lag.description: How many steps back to compare with.

Diff.title: Diff

DoG.description: Difference of Gaussians: enhances blob-like structures of a chosen size, suppresses background.

sigma.description: Size of structures to enhance, in voxels (smaller blur).

ratio.description: Larger blur = sigma × ratio. 1.6 approximates a Laplacian of Gaussian.

gain.description: Multiply the difference so the result uses the 0..255 range.

DoG.title: DoG

Gaussian.description: Gaussian blur (smoothing). Reduces noise before thresholding; larger sigma = blurrier.

sigma.description: Blur width in voxels (standard deviation). 1 removes pixel noise; 3-5 merges small structures.

truncate.description: Kernel radius in units of sigma. Rarely needs changing; 3 keeps 99.7% of the kernel. Determines the halo: ceil(sigma × truncate) voxels of neighbouring data are read on each side.

Gaussian.title: Gaussian

Label.description:
Connected components of a mask, coloured as segments. Labels are unique per chunk, so one
object spanning several chunks gets several colours; that is the honest per-chunk preview.

min_size.description: Drop components smaller than this many voxels (counted within the chunk + halo).

Label.title: Label

Morphology.description: Binary morphology on a mask: remove specks (open), fill holes (close), shrink or grow.

operation.description: open = erode then dilate (removes small objects); close = dilate then erode (fills small gaps); erode; dilate.

radius.description: Radius of the spherical structuring element, in voxels.

Morphology.title: Morphology

OpSpec.title: OpSpec
OpSpec.description: One entry of a pipeline's ops: an op's name and its parameters.

PipelineSpec.description: JSON-serializable description of a pipeline (what the REST API and CLI exchange).

select.description: Pin non-spatial axes to one index each, e.g. {"c": 1, "t": 0}: the pipeline sees that channel of that time point, without those axes

PipelineSpec.title: PipelineSpec

RegisterParams.description:
The query of a ``register://`` URL. The one definition of it: the browser engine
(``web/``) generates its TypeScript types and form defaults from this model's JSON
Schema (``chunkmirage schema``).

fixed.description: The fixed image: anything open_source reads. The output has its grid and levels.

affine.description: The fixed-to-moving affine in physical units, C order: a .npy or text file holding a 4x4 or 3x4 matrix, or its 12 or 16 values inline, row by row; or auto, to find one from the images' intensity moments and a correlation fit. Default: identity.

fixed_channel.description: The fixed image's channel to match on, for images with a c axis.

moving_channel.description: The moving image's channel to match on; the output has every channel of the moving image.

levels.description: Fixed-image levels to solve on, coarse to fine. Default: from the coarsest with at least 16 voxels on every axis to the finest with at most 2^25.

iterations.description: Adam steps per level: one value, one per level, or one per level including the refined ones. 0 skips the solve (the affine alone).

refine.description: Levels below the solved ones whose field is fitted on demand, block by block, where it is viewed: refine=2 with levels 6,5,4 fits levels 3 and 2, a block (one output chunk) when a chunk it covers is first requested, from the solved field, coarse to fine within the block. The finest fitted level's field serves every finer one.

halo.description: Voxels of context on every side of a block whose field is fitted on demand: how far beyond the block the fit looks, so neighbouring blocks agree.

block.description: Voxels per block of a field fitted on demand, C order. Independent of the output's chunks: a chunk's field reaches into the neighbouring blocks, so blocks deeper than a thin chunk fit fewer voxels in all, even for one slice.

smooth.description: Weight of the penalty on the field's gradient.

grid.description: Control-point spacing of the field, in voxels of each level.

window.description: Correlation window, voxels, odd: one value, one per level, or one per level including the refined ones. Fine levels gain from a wider one.

show.description: image: the registered moving image; pair: a c axis of two, the fixed image's channel then the registered one; field: u itself, components first, in physical units.

frames.description: A leading t axis of that many fields from the solve, from none (the affine alone) to the final one, to watch it converge.

interpolation.description: Default: nearest for uint32/uint64 (labels), else linear.

chunk.description: Output chunk shape of the spatial axes, C order. Default: the fixed image's.

device.description: auto (the GPU with the most free memory, else the CPU), cpu, cuda:1, ...

RegisterParams.title: RegisterParams

Scale.description: Linear intensity rescale ``value * factor + offset`` (output is float32).
Scale.title: Scale

Spots.description:
Bright diffraction-limited spots, such as single mRNA molecules in smFISH or EASI-FISH:
a difference of Gaussians, its local maxima above ``threshold``, each drawn as a small
ball. A spot's id comes from its position in the volume, so one spot keeps its id and
colour whichever chunk finds it.

sigma.description: Spot size, in voxels along y and x: the smaller blur of the difference of Gaussians (the larger is 1.6 times it). About the spot's standard deviation.

sigma_z.description: The same along z, in z voxels: smaller than sigma when z voxels are coarser, as in most light microscopy.

threshold.description: Least difference-of-Gaussians response a spot needs, in the image's intensity units: higher finds fewer, brighter spots.

separation.description: Spots closer than this, in y-x voxels, are one: the radius of the local maximum search.

radius.description: Radius of the ball drawn for each spot, in y-x voxels (0 marks one voxel).

Spots.title: Spots

Threshold.description: Binary mask: voxels with ``low <= value < high`` become ``value``, everything else 0.

low.description: Lower bound (inclusive), in the source's intensity units. Voxels at or above it pass.

high.description: Upper bound (exclusive). Leave empty for no upper bound. Use it to select an intensity band.

value.description: Label written for voxels that pass (1 shows as one segment in Neuroglancer).

Threshold.title: Threshold

Uniform.description: Box (mean) filter: each voxel becomes the average of a size³ cube around it.

size.description: Edge length of the averaging cube, in voxels (odd values are centred).

Uniform.title: Uniform
